integrity: The transfer decomposition, cylinder image and classical Sturmian frequencies are cited prior mathematics; only the full quantitative transfer oscillation classification is assessed here. scientific_limitations: One-sided Sturmian system, centered Lipschitz observables and continuous transfers only; arithmetic endpoint depends on convergent denominator ratios; no multidimensional or non-Sturmian extension proved.
title: Sharp logarithmic regularity spectrum of Sturmian cohomological transfers
